meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能为 NanoClaw 添加 DeltaChat 通道，用它通过邮件收发消息并加密。Claude 会完成安装、配置邮箱凭据，并运行测试确认一切正常。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 DeltaChat 通道、配置邮箱连接或把聊天接到 DeltaChat 群组时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 NanoClaw 里加上 DeltaChat 通道
say.note: Claude 会开始安装并配置。

say.text: 配置 DeltaChat 的邮箱 IMAP 和 SMTP 凭据
把 DeltaChat 聊天接到智能体群组

howto.what_en: Adds DeltaChat channel support to NanoClaw: messages are exchanged over email with end-to-end encryption. It completes installation, configures mailbox credentials, and runs tests to confirm everything works.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a DeltaChat channel, configure mailbox connection, or wire a chat to a DeltaChat group.

say_en.text: Add a DeltaChat channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude will start installing and configuring.

say_en.text: Set up the IMAP and SMTP mailbox credentials for DeltaChat.
Wire the DeltaChat chat to an agent group.
